sections.content: How many people are "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters"?

33,275 people

were counted on the census as "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Glaziers, window fabricators and fitters make and install pre-glazed wooden, metal or PVC framework, and cut, fit and set glass in windows, doors, shop fronts, and other structural frames.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters" there were more men than women (98.2% compared with 1.8%).

This means "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "skilled construction and building trades".

Men made up 98.2% and women made up 1.8% of "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters" included:

  • floorers and wall tilers
  • large goods vehicle drivers
  • mobile machine drivers and operatives (other)

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters", 13.3% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters" was 16 to 19 years.

The percentage of men and women who are "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "glaziers, window fabricators and fitters", 7.2% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (86.8% compared with 13.2%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (52.5%) than self-employed (47.5%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Barnsley, this is in the region of the Yorkshire & Humberside.
